```{r}
#| include: false
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", "."), "R", "site.R"))
proj <- site_links()
proj <- proj[proj$group == "projects", ]
links <- setNames(proj$url, proj$label)
```

I build R and Shiny tools for the unglamorous middle of applied research: documenting, cleaning, linking, and reporting on administrative data.

```{r}
#| results: asis
d <- cv_data("software_dev")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
  cat("## ", md(d$name[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("*", md(d$role[i]), " · ", md(d$when[i]), "*\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(md(d$description[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (d$name[i] %in% names(links)) {
    cat("[Source on GitHub](", links[[d$name[i]]], "){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("*Internal tool; not publicly available.*\n\n")
  }
}
```
